title: Candidate
description: One selectable source for one cube, barrel or sale. Identity for validation is kind + tile-id + city only; price, owner and bonus are incidental.

kind.description: board-tile: a mine, works or brewery on the board. market: the coal or iron market (with a price), or a merchant destination for a sale or barrel (with a city and no price).

tile-id.description: Built-tile id, on a board-tile candidate. Part of the identity triple.

city.description: Board-location id: where the tile stands, or which merchant a sale or barrel comes from. Part of the identity triple.

owner-id.description: Owner of the board tile. Any owner's resources may be consumed; shown so the player knows whose mine they are draining. Incidental to identity.

price.description: Money for one cube from the coal or iron market at its current count. Absent on merchant candidates. Incidental to identity, because it goes stale as the market moves.

bonus.description: Printed reward this merchant's free barrel fires when consumed. Present only on a commerce-barrel candidate from the sell planner, for display. Incidental to identity.
